children: US regional bank's Q3 net income and EPS rose yr/yr on higher loan yields and lower costs
Net interest income for Q3 increased 11.2% from prior year
Efficiency ratio improved to 50.7% from 57.9% yr/yr, reflecting expense management
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future periods
LOAN YIELD INCREASE - Co said a 26 basis point rise in loan yields contributed to higher net income in Q3
LOWER COST OF FUNDS - Co attributed improved results to a 9 basis point reduction in cost of funds
BANK OWNED LIFE INSURANCE PAYOUT - Co said net income was boosted by a payout following the death of a former employee
